blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Bogo City’s P217.5-million housing project for families displaced by Super Typhoon Yolanda remains incomplete, with the P32.62-million advance payment released to the contractor in 2021 still unrecouped and no housing structures built. This was according to a Commission on Audit (COA) report dated September 29, 2026. The National Housing Authority (NHA)-funded […]...
